subject: reasoning
question:
Two positions of the same dice are given. What digit will be on the face opposite to the face having the digit 5 ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5599a60375b0aa1e332f3c19cc93f6caf40c47241780e7f05b68b8962bed5479.png]
solution:
We can see the figures given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d32fcebc729331416d713bf11551b67c0004eb9e3a7326e54f365a55fdd9727.png] 

When we turn the dice with face 1 at the same position, now in the 1st figure 5 was at right side of the dice and in the 2nd figure 3 was at the right side of the dice so we can say that **3 is the face opposite to 5 because when we move the dice we will get the opposite face on the same position.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
